# Refine tagging strategy for documentation

## Description
Current tagging strategy has redundancies: the tag `resources` appears on 17 of 17 files, adding little filtering value. Tags like `figma-api` and `api-docs` co-occur on the same 11 files, creating unnecessary overlap. Need to refine tags to be more meaningful and granular.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Remove generic `resources` tag from all files (or keep only on top-level index)
- [ ] Consolidate overlapping tags: choose either `figma-api` or `api-docs` for API-related files
- [ ] Add more specific tags where appropriate (e.g., `design-tokens`, `asset-export`, `backup`, `rate-limiting`)
- [ ] Ensure each file has 2-5 meaningful tags that aid discovery
- [ ] Update frontmatter in all documentation markdown files

## References
- Research findings: `.tmp/researches/assistant-research-documentation-organization.md` (lines 63-64, 72-75)
- Current tags can be viewed with `zk tag list` or by examining frontmatter

## Notes
- Consider enabling colon-tags in `.zk/config.toml` (`colon-tags = true`) for hierarchical tagging (separate issue)
- Tag synonyms: decide on singular vs. plural forms (e.g., `sdk` not `sdks`)
- Add a "category" tag to indicate primary category (`category:figma-api`, `category:github`)

title: Convert documentation links to wiki-style for Zk integration
description:
# Convert documentation links to wiki-style for Zk integration

## Description
Zk is configured for wiki-style links (`[[note-title]]`) but internal links currently use standard Markdown relative paths (`[link](path.md)`). This limits backlink detection and Zk's navigation features. Convert all internal documentation links to wiki-style format.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Identify all internal Markdown links within the `docs/` directory
- [ ] Convert relative path links to wiki-style links using note titles
- [ ] Ensure Zk can resolve the links (titles match note titles)
- [ ] Verify that `zk links` and `zk backlinks` work correctly
- [ ] Update any link references in index files

## References
- Research findings: `.tmp/researches/assistant-research-documentation-organization.md` (lines 65-66, 77)
- Zk configuration: `docs/.zk/config.toml` already has `link-format = "wiki"`
- Zk documentation on wiki links: https://github.com/zk-org/zk/blob/main/docs/wiki-links.md

## Notes
- Wiki links use note titles (from frontmatter `title` field) not filenames
- If a note title contains spaces or special characters, wrap in `[[Note Title]]`
- Consider adding aliases for alternative titles
- Test with `zk list --format full` to see titles
